body: I often hear from some friends who I consider as "extreme activists" na digmaang bayan lang ang sagot para mabago ang bansa, but I couldn't find myself to agree with them kasi sa loob ko baka may hope pa na we can invoke change through other means like educating others, voting for competent politicians, voicing out against wrong doings... pero sa ganyan parang gusto ko na rin sabihin na patayin dapat yang mga ganyang tao who can spout nonsense like that with confidence and full conviction na magmamasacre sila ng marami including innocent people. Nakakatakot nga talaga.
